mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.preparation_id, c.section_key, c.input_revision, c.content_kind, c.content_text, c.facts_json, c.run_id, c.created_at, c.confirmed_at FROM application_preparation_content c JOIN application_preparation p ON p.id = c.preparation_id WHERE c.preparation_id = #{preparationId} AND p.owner_account_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_preparation_content (preparation_id, section_key, input_revision, content_kind, content_text, facts_json, run_id, created_at) VALUES (#{preparationId}, #{sectionKey}, #{inputRevision}, #{contentKind}, #{contentText}, #{factsJson}, #{runId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE application_preparation_content SET confirmed_at = COALESCE(confirmed_at, #{confirmedAt}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_preparation_draft_run (preparation_id, section_key, input_revision, expected_version_id, request_key, run_status, input_json, started_at) VALUES (#{preparationId}, #{sectionKey}, #{inputRevision}, #{expectedVersionId}, #{requestKey}, #{runStatus}, #{inputJson}, #{startedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM application_preparation_draft_run WHERE preparation_id = #{preparationId} AND section_key = #{sectionKey} AND run_status = 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE application_preparation_draft_run SET run_status = #{status}, output_json = #{outputJson}, applied = #{applied}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND run_status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE application_preparation SET updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{preparationId}
